predecessors.name: Grand Principality of Moscow
predecessors.text: Gorodets Meshchersky on the Oka and its district, 'the lands which Grand Prince Vasily II of Moscow presented in 1452' to Qasim

predecessors.name: Golden Horde
predecessors.text: the Oka district of Gorodets Meshchersky, in the lands that had been Golden Horde territory (infobox 'Preceded by: Golden Horde')

successors.name: Tsardom of Russia
successors.text: Kasimov and the middle Oka, 'within modern-day Ryazan Oblast'

ledger.x: 1452: Vasily II gives Gorodets Meshchersky to the Kazan prince Qasim, founding the Qasim Khanate.
1502: a sliver on the south-east edge is added.

wars.name: Russo-Kazan War of 1467-1469
wars.outcome: 'Ivan failed to get Qasim on the throne of Kazan, and had to recognise Ibrahim as the legitimate successor'; the 1469 treaty followed and 'Qasim died soon after'.

wars.name: Muscovite siege of Kazan (1487)
wars.outcome: 'Prince Kholmsky sailed down the Volga from Nizhny Novgorod and laid siege to Kazan on 18 May 1487', and 'Moxammat Amin was proclaimed the new khan'.

wars.name: Russian conquest of Kazan (1552)
wars.outcome: 'the final siege of the Tatar capital commenced on 30 August' and 'the final storming on 2 October led to the taking of the city of Kazan'; 'Shahghali took part in the final Russian conquest of Kazan in 1552' (Shahghali page).

certainty.note: A fief on the Oka granted by Moscow; the page gives no boundary survey, so the outline is Cliopatria's approximation throughout.
